edit.description: channel_load_moment: an invoking channel (user-invoked, description-trigger, paths-listing) loads the body on demand, per clause §load moment; the None set narrows to the channels whose content never enters context
skill, command and agent fixtures under a loads guard

summary: An invoked skill, command or agent loads on demand, so a loads(on-demand) guard binds its body there instead of staying silent
acceptance: a `when(loads("on-demand"), …)` clause on the skill, command or agent contract judges every member; one on `launch` judges none
tests: a loads on-demand guard binds its body on an invoked skill
a loads on-demand guard binds its body on an agent
a loads on-demand guard binds its body on a command
pins: a load moment guard binds its body on a member that loads on demand
a load moment guard is silent on a member that loads at launch
notes: Only the body is the load; the description listing stays the listing budget's (0120 amendment). The refusal half of the amendment (a guard on a kind whose content never enters context) waits on question load-moment-refusal-class. imported_file_moment reads these moments too: an unclaimed file a skill's directive arcs reach gains on-demand.
